imageHelp: Use as the model for /v1/images/generations or /v1/images/edits, or for the Responses image_generation tool. Enabled models appear in /v1/models. Requests for disabled models are rejected by the platform. Free plan accounts cannot use Images endpoints.
mappingHelp: When a requested model matches an alias, the platform rewrites it to the selected GPT model before forwarding. codex-auto-review is the hidden model used by Codex automatic approval review (guardian).
catalogHelp: Context and reasoning capabilities come from the upstream Codex catalog; refresh with Sync GPT. GPT requests do not use Claude thinking / max_tokens normalization, so there are no parameters to adjust here. Use Model mappings above for aliases.
openaiOverrideDescription: Input / cached input / output are required (USD / 1M); cache write is optional. Key {{key}}
sync14008EffortUnsupported: The CLI catalog may define a default, but this model's provider rejects effort, so no value is added.
